EvidenceRequest.meaning: A synthetic or consenting runner request to attach candidate activity evidence, never verified geometry or score.

consentAcknowledged.meaning: Whether the caller explicitly supplied boolean true.

activityPresent.meaning: Whether the activity identifier passed the HTTP string adapter.

consentTextPresent.meaning: Whether the consent explanation passed the HTTP string adapter.

EvidenceConsentRequired.meaning: All three facts must be true before any activity evidence is persisted.
